attributes._AI_CONTEXT:
/**
 * AI-CONTEXT:
 * 
 * Purpose:
 * - Keycloak realm configuration export. Maps roles, clients, and valid redirect URIs for SSO.
 * 
 * Scope:
 * - Defines the 'treishvaam' realm.
 * - Must never contain live credentials (passwords must be placeholder/temporary).
 * 
 * Critical Dependencies:
 * - Backend: Finance API relies on 'finance-api' client.
 * - Frontend: Finance Frontend relies on 'finance-app' client.
 * - Worker / SEO / Sitemap: Unaffected directly.
 * 
 * Security Constraints:
 * - redirectUris and webOrigins MUST be strictly whitelisted.
 * - Never use wildcards for root domains.
 * - Must remain valid JSON format.
 * - Hardcoded URLs are strictly prohibited. Must use environment variables.
 * 
 * Non-Negotiables:
 * - Must reflect the exact live state of the production Keycloak instance.
 * 
 * Change Intent:
 * - Resolving Keycloak container crash loop by moving this AI-CONTEXT inside the native attributes map.
 * - Enforcing ZERO-TRUST configuration by removing hardcoded URLs and using environment variables for redirect URIs.
 * - Fix Task 4 (CVE-006): Ensure bruteForceProtected is enforced via JSON config.
 * 
 * Future AI Guidance:
 * - Append to IMMUTABLE CHANGE HISTORY inside this JSON property. Do not use block comments outside of strings in JSON files.
 * - NEVER place this context string at the root level of the JSON. It must remain inside the "attributes" map.
 * 
 * IMMUTABLE CHANGE HISTORY (DO NOT DELETE):
 * - ADDED:
 * • Initial Realm Export
 * • To backup and track Keycloak configuration via Git
 * 
 * - EDITED:
 * • Updated redirectUris and webOrigins for finance-app client.
 * • Required due to domain migration from treishfin.treishvaamgroup.com to treishvaamfinance.com.
 * • Added explicit whitelisting for both apex and www subdomains.
 * • Preserved localhost references for developer environments.
 * 
 * - EDITED:
 * • Moved `_AI_CONTEXT` from the root JSON level into the `"attributes"` map.
 * • Why: Keycloak 22+ uses strict Jackson JSON parsing. Unrecognized root properties caused `UnrecognizedPropertyException`, crashing the Keycloak container on boot.
 * 
 * - EDITED:
 * • Removed hardcoded URLs from `finance-app` client configuration.
 * • Injected environment variables for `redirectUris` and set `webOrigins` to `+` to adhere to zero-trust architecture. Fixed CORS / Auth Timeout issue.
 * 
 * - EDITED:
 * • Enabled Keycloak Brute Force Protection by adding `bruteForceProtected`, `failureFactor`, `waitIncrementSeconds`, and `maxFailureWaitSeconds`.
 * • Why: Fix Task 4 brute force vulnerability (CVE-006).
 * 
 * - EDITED:
 * • Added explicit production (`https://treishvaamfinance.com`, `https://www.treishvaamfinance.com`) and local (`http://localhost:3000`) origins to `webOrigins` in addition to `+`.
 * • Why: Resolves Keycloak 25 `silent-check-sso.html` iframe framing block when admin UI login is inaccessible, guaranteeing valid CSP `frame-ancestors` headers without compromising proxy security.
 */
